battle.name: 高歡攻爾朱氏之戰
battle.brief: 北魏末年，高歡起兵信都，擁立宗室元朗號令河北，率軍進逼鄴城，以蒙牛皮的橦車破城而入。旋與爾朱兆大軍遇於鄴城南韓陵，結圓陣、連繫牛驢，大破號稱二十萬之敵，河北遂歸高氏。卡面的羅馬方陣盾不在此戰，它指的是同一個道理：防線靠咬合與封閉成立，此戰的盾牆是前列漢軍的木楯與長槊。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的一方是北魏末年盤據河北的爾朱氏集團。首領爾朱榮出身契胡，早年在六鎮軍戶中崛起，528年以「清君側」為名入洛陽，製造河陰之變，沉胡太后與幼主於河，屠戮朝臣百官，隨後以爾朱氏子弟分掌州鎮：爾朱兆鎮晉陽、爾朱度律鎮鄴、爾朱世隆鎮洛陽、爾朱天光鎮潼關。旗下核心是契胡與六鎮降戶組成的騎兵，漢人州鎮兵與豪族私兵為輔，並藉強行徵發河北民力修城築壘。反方是起兵河北的高歡集團：他在信都舉兵，擁立宗室元朗為主以號令河北，靠六鎮降戶與契胡騎兵起家，又得孫騰、封隆、高乾兄弟等漢人幕僚與河北州鎮豪右的支持，兵源與爾朱氏同出一源，旗號卻不同。戰事全在河北：東面河北平原是主戰場，鄴城是必爭的都城要地，晉陽是爾朱氏的西北根本，而洛陽朝廷與南朝梁、蕭、楊等勢力在此戰中只是旁觀。
countriesEn: One side was the Erzhu clan that dominated Hebei in the late Northern Wei. Its head, Erzhu Rong, was of Xianbei descent and had risen inside the military households of the Six Garrisons; in 528 he entered Luoyang under the banner of clearing the court of evil ministers, staged the Heyin massacre, drowned the empress dowager Hu and the child emperor in the river, and killed the court officials. He then distributed power among his own kinsmen: Erzhu Zhao at Jinyang, Erzhu Dulu at Ye, Erzhu Shilong at Luoyang, Erzhu Tiangua at Tong Pass. The core of this force was the Xianbei and surrendered Six Garrisons cavalry, with Han Chinese prefectural troops and the private soldiers of the local gentry as auxiliaries; Hebei manpower was conscripted without mercy to build walls and palisades. The other side was the coalition Gao Huan built in Hebei: he rose at Xindu, set up the imperial prince Yuan Lang as a figurehead in order to give orders in Hebei, and built his army on the same surrendered Six Garrisons men and Xianbei cavalry, backed by Han Chinese advisers such as Sun Teng, Feng Long and the Gao Qian brothers, and by the great families of the Hebei prefectures. Both armies drew their manpower from the same stock; only the banner differed. The war was fought entirely in Hebei: the eastern plains were the main theatre, Ye was the city that had to be taken, Jinyang was the Erzhu root in the northwest, while the Luoyang court and the southern Liang, Xiao and Yang regimes were only bystanders.
people: 高歡（496—547），鮮卑名賀六渾，勃海蓨縣人，祖上隨慕容氏北遷，六鎮之亂後與葛榮、杜洛周同起事，投爾朱榮麾下，以驍騎將軍之任統六鎮降戶。爾朱榮被自己姪子爾朱兆等人所殺後，他恐怕受累，藉口鎮壓六鎮降戶，率眾北走信都。孫騰等漢人幕僚勸他奉宗室元朗為主，高歡依計建大魏旗號。河北起兵之後，段韶是韓陵一戰的執行者：他以數百精騎出陣挑戰，佯裝不支而退，誘使敵軍追入陣前，再與全軍合擊，是全場關鍵。從弟高敖曹素以驍勇著稱，韓陵之役率先鋒陷陣，縱騎追擊至滏口，數次中箭不卻。敵方主帥爾朱兆承其主力與契胡騎兵，急於追滅高歡；部將慕容紹宗鎮幽州，與高歡對峙，後來歸降。守鄴的尚般、鎮洛陽的爾朱世隆、據鄴的爾朱度律各守一方，爾朱度律一度廢立皇帝，逼高歡拒絕入朝，最終促成決裂。被高歡立為主的元朗、原本受爾朱氏控制的孝莊帝元子攸，以及在河北替高歡徵兵輸糧的州鎮豪右，共同構成這場戰爭棋盤上的人。
peopleEn: Gao Huan (496-547), whose Xianbei name was Heluhun, came from Diao county in the commandery of Bohai; his ancestors had followed the Murong clan northward, and after the rebellion of the Six Garrisons he rose with Ge Rong and Du Luozhou before entering Erzhu Rong's service, where he was put in charge of the surrendered garrison men as a cavalry general. Once Erzhu Rong had been killed by his own nephews, Erzhu Zhao and the rest, Gao Huan feared for his own safety and asked to be given the surrendered Six Garrisons troops, then marched north with them to Xindu. Han Chinese advisers such as Sun Teng urged him to raise the banner of the imperial prince Yuan Lang, and Gao Huan did so, proclaiming a Great Wei of his own. Once the rising in Hebei was under way, Duan Shao was the man who carried the day at Hanling: he took several hundred picked cavalry out of the line to give battle, pretended to give way, drew the enemy in past the front of the formation, and then struck together with the whole army. Gao Aocao, Gao Huan's cousin, was famed for his courage; at Hanling he led the charge into the enemy line, rode the pursuit as far as the Fukou, and kept going though he was struck by arrows more than once. On the other side Erzhu Zhao inherited his uncle's main force and his Xianbei cavalry and was determined to destroy Gao Huan at once; his general Murong Shaozong, who held Youzhou and matched Gao Huan across the border, would later surrender. Shang Ban, who defended Ye, Erzhu Shilong at Luoyang and Erzhu Dulu at Ye each held a section of the front, and it was Erzhu Dulu's deposition of one emperor and enthronement of another that forced Gao Huan to refuse the summons to court and finally brought the two sides to war. Yuan Lang, the prince Gao Huan set up as ruler, Emperor Xiaozhuang, who had been under Erzhu control, and the Hebei great families who raised men and grain for Gao Huan together made up the human geography of this conflict.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾，與五三一年的河北戰場並無血緣關係。凸面長方盾是羅馬軍團的裝備，盾體修長，寬可及肩，高度過胸，中央有盾臍，握把與臂柲在盾後；持盾者並不指望它擋住衝撞，而是讓相鄰的盾緣互相咬住，把一列盾牌連成一堵可以承力的牆，再由後排的短劍與標槍在盾縫後出手。卡面那句「防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚」，正是此戰的說明書：真正決定勝負的是封閉與承力的方式。此戰的實際裝備則完全是另一套北方體系。漢人步兵用木楯、札盾、葛布盾一類的盾牌結陣，前面持盾蔽身，後面以長槊配合，組成可以互相推壓的密集隊形；契胡騎兵是爾朱氏與高歡共同的底牌，配備人馬甲、札甲與長刀，機動與衝撞是主要戰法。攻城一方靠橦車，即蒙牛皮的撞車，以牛拉曳抵近城牆，撞擊城堞，守軍懼其逼近而不敢俯射；弓弩是守城與野戰的常備火力，糧秣靠牛馬與車輛輸送，運力就是戰力。隋唐以前北朝軍隊並不使用羅馬式的圓凸長方盾，兩者之間只存在「以盾結牆」這個共通點，卡面因此取其理而不取其物。
kitsEn: The scutum shown on the card has no blood relation to the battlefield of Hebei in 531. The convex rectangular shield was the equipment of the Roman legions: the body was long, broad enough to cover the shoulder and taller than the chest, with an umbo at the centre, a grip and arm rest at the back. The man carrying it did not expect it to stop a charge; he expected it to lock edge to edge with the shields beside him, so that a rank of shields became a wall able to take the load, while short swords and javelins were thrown from behind the seams. The line on the card, that the Roman line held by biting shield rim to shield rim rather than by the thickness of the boards, is exactly the reading key for this battle: what decided it was the way the formation was closed and how the load was carried. The actual equipment of this campaign belonged to an entirely different northern system. Han Chinese infantry formed up with wooden shields, plank shields and cloth-covered shields, the front rank holding shields to cover the body and the rear rank pressing with long spears, so that the whole body stood in a dense line able to shove and support one another. Xianbei cavalry was the shared foundation of both Erzhu and Gao Huan, equipped with armour for man and horse, lamellar plates and long knives, mobility and impact being their principal method. On the attacking side, the battering ram, the ox-drawn cart sheathed in oxhide, was pushed up to the wall and hammered against the parapet, and the defenders were afraid to shoot down at a cart that had come so close. Bows and crossbows were the standing firepower of both siege and field, while grain and fodder travelled on cattle and wagons, so that transport was itself a form of combat power. The armies of the northern courts before the Sui and the Tang never used the convex Roman rectangle; the only point shared between the two was the principle of closing a wall with shields, and so the card takes the reasoning and not the object.
tactics: 高歡的戰法是先取鄴城，再在城郊吃掉敵軍主力。他不用硬撞城牆，而是先造橦車：牛皮蒙覆的撞車以牛拉曳，前端抵住城堞反覆撞擊，攻城效果遠勝臨時架起的雲梯，因為守軍無法俯射貼近的車體。城破之日，守軍分崩，守將尚般或死或降，諸說並存，總之鄴城在數十日內易手。得手後高歡沒有北上晉陽迎敵，而是背鄴城而陳，把戰場選在城南韓陵：北面有城牆作依托，只需單面應敵，士卒不必分心顧背。兵力上他以不滿三萬對爾朱兆自稱二十萬的大軍，於是收縮成圓陣，並以牛驢連綴，使各段首尾相屬，前列被衝擊時後列可以補上，敵軍也難從兩翼迂迴；另有一說，這批牛驢同時用來堵塞敵軍退路。決戰的節點在先手：段韶率數百精騎出陣挑戰，偽裝不支而退，誘使爾朱兆的前鋒追過陣前，高歡大軍這才全線展開合擊。契胡騎兵慣於奔射衝突，一旦被引入圓陣的縱深，追勢難收，前隊一亂，後隊無所依憑，潰勢遂成。高歡乘勝追擊至滏口，晉陽門戶洞開。
tacticsEn: Gao Huan's method was to take Ye first and then destroy the main body of the enemy in the fields outside the city. He did not try to smash the wall directly but built battering carts first: the oxhide-covered ram was drawn up by oxen, set against the parapet and hammered repeatedly, and it worked far better than improvised scaling ladders, because the defenders could not shoot down at a cart that had come so close. The day the city fell the garrison broke; whether the defender Shang Ban died or surrendered is told in different ways, but Ye changed hands within a matter of tens of days. Instead of marching north to meet the enemy at Jinyang, Gao Huan planted himself with his back to Ye and chose the ground south of the city at Hanling: the city wall behind him meant he had to meet the enemy on one front only, and the men never had to worry about their backs. In numbers he was at a disadvantage, fewer than thirty thousand against an enemy who claimed two hundred thousand, so he closed up into a round formation and linked the oxen and donkeys together so that every part of the line was joined to the next; when the front was struck the rear could feed it, and the enemy found it hard to turn the flanks; another account says the same beasts were used to block the enemy's road of retreat. The moment of the battle lay in who struck first: Duan Shao led several hundred picked cavalry out of the line to give battle, pretended to give way, drew Erzhu Zhao's vanguard past the front of the formation, and only then did Gao Huan's army deploy along the whole line and strike. Xianbei cavalry was used to galloping shots and shock; once drawn into the depth of the round formation they could not check their pursuit, the front ranks broke, the rear ranks had nothing to lean on, and the rout followed. Gao Huan pursued them to the Fukou, and the gate of Jinyang was left standing open.
data: 留下數字的戰役記錄並不完整，可核的幾項大致如下。圍攻鄴城歷時約五十日（亦有記作數十日者），高歡在此之前已把河北州鎮的徵發握在手中。韓陵一戰，高歡自有兵力「不滿三萬」，對手爾朱兆自號二十萬眾，雙方兵數相差數倍，中間全靠陣形與指揮取補。段韶出陣挑戰所領精騎，記作五百之數。戰果方面，斬首以萬計，俘獲與繳獲鎧仗甚眾，殘部被追至滏口、晉陽一帶，爾朱兆再無可用之兵。距離上，韓陵在鄴城南數十里，至晉陽約百餘里，追擊一日可達；糧秣方面，牛馬是河北軍隊唯一的大宗運力，故高歡攻城與野戰都把牛驢隊列算作戰術的一部分。爾朱氏在河北經營多年，州鎮與部曲之眾號稱以十萬計，但其中契胡騎兵與六鎮降戶一旦被高歡帶走，數字的底子就空了。史載有限，具體斬獲數字各家記載不一，宜以「以萬計」概之。
dataEn: The written record of this campaign is incomplete, but a few figures can be checked. The siege of Ye lasted about fifty days, though some accounts put it at no more than a few tens of days; before the siege Gao Huan already had the levies of the Hebei prefectures in his hands. At Hanling Gao Huan's own strength is given as fewer than thirty thousand, against an enemy whom Erzhu Zhao numbered at two hundred thousand, so the whole difference had to be made up by formation and command. The picked cavalry Duan Shao took out to give battle is recorded as five hundred men. As for the result, the enemy lost and prisoners were taken in the thousands, with a great deal of armour and weapons captured, and the broken remainder was chased to the Fukou and the neighbourhood of Jinyang, leaving Erzhu Zhao no force that could be used again. In terms of distance, Hanling lies several tens of li south of Ye and rather more than a hundred li from Jinyang, close enough for a day's pursuit. On supply, draught cattle and horses were the only large-scale haulage the Hebei armies had, which is why Gao Huan counted herds of oxen and donkeys as part of his tactics in both the siege and the field. The Erzhu clan had governed Hebei for years and its prefectural and departmental troops were said to number in the tens of thousands, but once the Xianbei cavalry and the surrendered garrison men had been carried off by Gao Huan the base under those numbers was empty. The sources are thin and the casualty counts differ from account to account, so it is safest to say that the enemy was destroyed by the tens of thousands.
cause: 起因是多層的。第一層是舊怨與新帳：527年冬胡太后毒死孝明帝，爾朱榮以清君側為名揮師入洛，528年把胡太后與幼主沉入黃河，殺戮朝臣百官，史稱河陰之變；河北州鎮被強行徵兵括戶，爾朱氏的酷吏與州鎮將吏動輒屠戮，河北士民怨怒已久。第二層是權力內部的裂痕：530年孝莊帝在洛陽謀殺爾朱榮，事後被拘於晉陽而縊殺；531年爾朱榮在晉陽被自己的姪子爾朱兆等人所殺，爾朱氏內部再無一個能統合各鎮的人，爾朱度律與爾朱世隆各據一州，互不相服。第三層是高歡自身的處境與野心：他本是爾朱榮麾下最得力的契胡將領，爾朱榮一死，他與爾朱氏的共犯關係立刻變成罪名；於是他以鎮壓六鎮降戶為名取得兵權，北走信都，再借河北宗室元朗的旗號起兵。朝廷徵他入朝、爾朱度律逼迫之下，他索性拒絕，把河北的軍政大權與河北士紳的擁戴一併收進自己懷裡，衝突遂無可挽回。
causeEn: The causes were layered. The first layer was old grievance and fresh debt: in the winter of 527 the empress dowager Hu poisoned Emperor Xiaoming, and Erzhu Rong marched on Luoyang in 528 under the banner of punishing the evil ministers, drowned the empress dowager and the child emperor in the Yellow River and killed the court, an event remembered as the Heyin massacre. The prefectures of Hebei were conscripted and their households registered by force, and the Erzhu family's harsh officials and local commanders butchered people as a matter of course, so resentment in Hebei was already deep. The second layer was a split inside the clan: in 530 Emperor Xiaozhuang tried to kill Erzhu Rong in Luoyang and was afterwards taken to Jinyang and strangled; in 531 Erzhu Rong was killed at Jinyang by his own nephews, Erzhu Zhao and the rest, and from that moment the Erzhu had no one left who could hold the provincial commands together, Erzhu Dulu and Erzhu Shilong each sitting on their own city and refusing to take orders from the other. The third layer was Gao Huan's own position and his ambition: he had been the most capable Xianbei commander under Erzhu Rong, and once Erzhu Rong was dead his complicity became a charge against him, so he secured troops under the pretext of suppressing the surrendered garrison men, marched north to Xindu, and rose under the banner of the Hebei prince Yuan Lang. When the court summoned him to the capital and Erzhu Dulu pressed the point, he simply refused, took the military and civil power of Hebei into his own hands together with the backing of Hebei's gentry, and from that point there was no turning back.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是北魏的實際命運在河北決定。爾朱氏的政權在大將喪敗、內部崩解與洛陽方面的連續失利中崩潰，532年爾朱世隆兵敗投河，河北與洛陽的殺戮與徵斂暫時停止，河北士人對爾朱氏的仇恨也隨之轉向高歡。高歡則由晉州刺史一躍為渤海王，把河北的州鎮、軍戶與糧秣收在自己手中，孝莊帝在532年被迎回鄴城，北魏朝廷自此寄於高氏之手；534年孝武帝西奔關中、高歡另立元善見遷都鄴城，東西魏對峙的前奏已經敲響，十六年後的玉壁之戰、其後的河橋與邙山之役都由此延伸。長期看，河北經過河陰之變與本次大戰的兵禍，戶口凋蔽，州鎮豪族各自擁兵自重，關隴集團在關中另起爐竈，隋唐之後的府兵與關隴貴族政治，都可以在這一輪北朝崩解裡找到源頭。而卡面那面羅馬方陣盾留下的觀念，恰好說明這個時代的本質：個人的勇武在會戰中只值一次衝鋒，真正決定歸屬的，是誰能讓一堵封閉的牆站得住。
impactEn: The upshot of the war was that the real fate of Northern Wei was decided in Hebei. The Erzhu regime collapsed through the defeat of its generals, its internal disintegration and a string of failures in the Luoyang front; in 532 Erzhu Shilong was beaten and drowned himself, and the killing and the exactions in Hebei and around Luoyang came to an end for the time being, the hatred of the Erzhu in Hebei turning instead towards Gao Huan. Gao Huan rose from being governor of Jinzhou to being Prince of Bohai, took the prefectures, the garrison households and the grain of Hebei into his own hands, and in 532 brought Emperor Xiaozhuang back to Ye, from which point the Northern Wei court existed on the sufferance of the Gao house. In 534 Emperor Xiaowu fled west to Guanzhong while Gao Huan set up Yuan Shanjian and moved the capital to Ye; the overture to the East Wei and West Wei confrontation had been struck, and the battle of Yubi sixteen years later, with the fighting at Heqiao and Mangshan after it, all grew out of this. In the long run Hebei, after the Heyin massacre and the ruin of this campaign, was thinned of population, the great families of the prefectures each kept troops of their own, and the Guanzhong group built a separate power in the west; the fubing system and the aristocratic politics of the Sui and Tang can be traced back to this dissolution of the northern courts. And the principle carried by that Roman scutum on the card describes the essence of the age: individual courage in a pitched battle is worth one charge, and what decides allegiance is who can keep a closed wall standing.
result: 點到為止：鄴城在高歡手上，河北歸高；爾朱兆在韓陵大敗，主力崩解，退保晉陽、朔州，兩年後再敗，為部將所殺，爾朱氏在河北的根基徹底斷絕。高歡乘勝追擊到滏口，晉陽門戶洞開，北方再無能與高歡抗衡的軍閥。洛陽方面的爾朱世隆在532年兵敗身死，朝廷得以喘息，孝莊帝回到鄴城。戰局未定的是南北：高歡挾河北之眾，關中的宇文泰也已經起家，兩邊都在收拾殘局，這場戰爭結束的只是爾朱氏的時代，北魏的分裂才剛開始。今人在史料中常以「高歡破爾朱於韓陵」一句概括這場戰役，而《北齊書》與《資治通鑑》留下的細節——圓陣、牛驢連綴、五百精騎的挑戰與僥倖的偽退——說明它不是一次單純的兵力較量。
resultEn: To sum it up: Ye was in Gao Huan's hands and Hebei went with him. Erzhu Zhao was badly beaten at Hanling, his main body fell apart, he fell back on Jinyang and Shuozhou, and two years later he was beaten again and killed by one of his own officers, so that the Erzhu root in Hebei was cut off for good. Gao Huan pursued as far as the Fukou; the gates of Jinyang stood open, and no military strongman in the north could face him again. At Luoyang Erzhu Shilong was beaten and killed in 532, the court got a breathing space, and Emperor Xiaozhuang was brought back to Ye. What remained unsettled lay to the south and the north: Gao Huan had the masses of Hebei, and in Guanzhong Yuwen Tai had already raised himself, each side picking up the pieces. This campaign ended only the age of the Erzhu; the division of Northern Wei had barely begun. Modern histories compress the whole affair into a single phrase, that Gao Huan broke Erzhu at Hanling, but the details left by the Bei Qi shu and the Zi Zhi Tong Jian, the round formation, the linked oxen and donkeys, the challenge of five hundred picked cavalry and the lucky feigned retreat, show that it was not a simple contest of numbers.
